planets.name: TOI-622 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of TOI-622 with a 6.4-day year, found in 2023.

text.card: TOI-622 b was found in 2023 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around TOI-622. Its orbit and size follow Psaridi et al. 2023's fit, the archive's default.
